result.summary: The page is mostly well-composed, but there is one clearly broken layout defect: the delivery time and delivery fee metadata under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' are rendered on top of each other, producing illegible overlapping text. A secondary, cosmetic inconsistency exists in the favorite (heart) button treatment between restaurant cards.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the metadata line shows overlapping text: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn in the same position, rendering as garbled '25–3€0delivery'. The two labels collide and are unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Render the metadata as a single inline row with proper spacing and a separator (e.g. '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'), or fix the absolutely-positioned/overlapping elements so each label occupies its own space. Ensure the container allows wrapping or truncation instead of overlap.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the ramen card has no circular scrim behind it, while the pizza card's heart sits on a dark circular background. On the busy ramen image the un-backed white outline heart has weaker contrast and looks inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background to the heart button on all restaurant cards for consistent styling and reliable contrast over any image.
